title: Composing exact O^a E^r interval maps around a CycleMin necklace produces a cyclic obstruction that is not an archived cell
statement: The interval transfer I_{i+1}=F_{a,r}(I_i) for blocks O^a E^r, composed around a CycleMin necklace with n <= V_i and P_i > V_i, yields global expansion, global contraction, or an empty run-type digraph that is not power_bound_word / cycle_trailing_evens_lt / excursion_map / corridor_bounds / 3^o/2^L / cycle_itinerary_formally_expanding / cycleMin_finance / the 365 vs 1517 split, and that outcome empties or tightens a leftover for a reason that is not an archived cell.
counterexamples: (1,1) is the archived OE cell z^4 <= x^3 < (z+1)^4; (2,1) is the OOE cell w^8 <= v^9; r=1 agrees with excursion_map
formal F_cycle is x^{3^o/2^L}; leftover L=19 and L=84 have outcome A, which is required expansion, not a contradiction; B is a contracting itinerary
(2,1) composed with (2,1) is 81/64 and 243<256, the archived (2,2,1) comparison
365 = (2,2,2,2) and 1517 = (2,2,2,1); the run-type digraph is not empty
notes: Phase 0 only. Not a run-length automaton, not a leftover census, not a finance reopen. F_{a,r} is a REPARAMETERIZATION of power_bound_word plus the even tower. No K=11, no L=25781 search, no Paper A edit, no ledger row, no new Lean. Not a halt theorem.
tested_range: OE/OOE cells; r=1 agreement at 365 and 1000057; formal leftovers 19 and 84; two-block (2,1)^2 and (2,1)o(1,1); first four runs of 365 and 1517
